verdict.rationale: SES can publish sending events, using configuration sets and message tags, to CloudWatch, Firehose, SNS, EventBridge or Pinpoint, and SNS can report bounces, complaints and deliveries. That gives a developer an event stream to collect and store themselves. However, nothing in the evidence shows open or click tracking or a per-message event-history query API. Community users say SES doesn't keep detailed logs and that you must build delivery reports yourself. Missing for 10: documented open/click tracking events, a queryable per-message event history via the API, and independent corroboration that event tracking works end-to-end.
